scope: Existing Pillow palette extraction helper and captured-byte validation hardening; no new Java core or source recreation

coverage: known colors and deterministic count/RGB order
uniform color and reduced sample counts
CLI output and preserved existing output
unsupported format and replacement between preflight and byte capture rejected before publication

review: Captured immutable bytes are checked against shared PNG/JPEG, pixel and byte limits before pixel decoding.
Decompression warning/error becomes controlled ValueError; source hash is checked again before publishing.
Existing documented application is a manual array replacement in FieldMarks; JSON is evidence, not a Java runtime schema.
limitations: Pillow-version-dependent quantization, no ICC/EXIF processing or optimal cyclic order.
This review does not establish new native palette-application evidence; C2 application demonstration remains pending.
